name: proton-bridge
description: Proton Mail Bridge skills over local IMAP. reply-draft: reply drafts that carry their reply context — reply-all recipients, a "Re:" subject and the original mail quoted under the text — stored in Drafts and read back, never sent. emails-to-github-issues: turn emails from named senders into deduplicated GitHub issues with thread grouping, inline screenshots and scope confirmation before writes.
